administrator_only.description: Whether the template should be available to administrators only

categories.description: A list of categories associated to the template

command.description: The command that will be executed in a container template

env.description: A list of environment(endpoint) variables used during the template deployment

image.description:
Mandatory container fields
Image associated to a container template. Mandatory for a container template

interactive.description:
Whether the container should be started in
interactive mode (-i -t equivalent on the CLI)

name.description:
Optional stack/container fields
Default name for the stack/container to be used on deployment

network.description: Name of a network that will be used on container deployment if it exists inside the environment(endpoint)

note.description: A note that will be displayed in the UI. Supports HTML content

platform.description:
Platform associated to the template.
Valid values are: 'linux', 'windows' or leave empty for multi-platform

ports.description: A list of ports exposed by the container

privileged.description: Whether the container should be started in privileged mode

registry.description:
Optional container fields
The URL of a registry associated to the image for a container template

stackFile.description:
Mandatory Edge stack fields
Stack file used for this template

type.description: Template type. Valid values are: 1 (container), 2 (Swarm stack), 3 (Compose stack), 4 (Compose edge stack)

volumes.description: A list of volumes used during the container template deployment

default.description: Default value that will be set for the variable

description.description: Content of the tooltip that will be generated in the UI

label.description: Text for the label that will be generated in the UI

preset.description: If set to true, will not generate any input for this variable in the UI

select.description: A list of name/value that will be used to generate a dropdown in the UI

default.description: Will set this choice as the default choice

text.description: Some text that will displayed as a choice

value.description: A value that will be associated to the choice

stackfile.description: Path to the stack file inside the git repository

url.description: URL of a git repository used to deploy a stack template. Mandatory for a Swarm/Compose stack template

readonly.description: Whether the volume used should be readonly
